'''Neelanon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|367|Neelanon}}</ref> located in the [[Neelanon system/Legends|Neelanon system]] of the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], a part of the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Senex Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] linked it to the [[Fengrine system/Legends|Fengrine]] and [[Senex system/Legends|Senex systems]], while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected it to the [[Crovna system/Legends|Crovna system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Neelanon was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[House Taneel]],<ref name="TEA" /> including the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Terr Taneel/Legends|Terr Taneel]].<ref name="DB" /> The planet also served as the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Senex [[Sector/Legends|sector]] with respect to Republic [[Administrator/Legends|administrative]] matters, though that status meant little in the internal affairs of the Senex-Juvex region.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Neelanon was first mentioned<ref name="DB" /> on [[May 11]], [[2005]],<ref name="UITSDB">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20050511.html|text=Unrest in the Senate}}</ref> in the original [[Databank (original)|Databank]] on [[StarWars.com]], in an entry dedicated to Terr Taneel.<ref name="DB" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
